entity.name: Al Maktoum International Airport Vertiport (DWC)
entity.meta_description: Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) was the landing site of the UAE's first piloted eVTOL flight on 9 November 2025. A formal vertiport is not confirmed by primary sources.
